name: Into the Fire

reserves.notes: Only through DEPLOY abilities that allow it; the battleplan sets no limit. Units still in reserve at the start of battle round 4 are destroyed (Core Rules 24.1).

special: GHB 2026-27: the roll-off winner chooses attacker or defender; the defender sets up the objectives and terrain, then the attacker picks a territory and begins deployment.
Core Rules 10.0: players alternate DEPLOY abilities; Deploy Regiment sets up a whole regiment without alternating.
Faction terrain is set up before units, starting with the player who deploys first.

notes: GHB 2026-27 battleplan 1 (Table 1), transcribed from the Wahapedia map image, which has no dimension annotations. Territory edges follow the map's quarter grid (x = 15/30/45, y = 11/22/33), so they are exact; they match the community cheat sheet by TheProducer, Barker and Oldtown Throwdown, via RodMal/aos-guru commit 4ba2dc6 (data/curated/battleplans/ghb-2026-27/into-the-fire.json). Stated objective centres (M5-T13), taken from the dimension labels printed on that cheat sheet (aos-guru into-the-fire.json:74-78, labelSeen; TRANSCRIPTION.md:19-24): sun-seekers (30, 5.5), from the printed "30x5.5" label (it mirrors heldenhain at 44 - 5.5 = 38.5); measuring had rounded it to y = 5. The other objective centres were measured from the Wahapedia image (about 0.15" accuracy) and rounded to the nearest 0.5": golden-lions-1 (15, 22), scions-of-the-comet (30, 22), golden-lions-2 (45, 22) and heldenhain (30, 38.5); each agrees with its printed cheat-sheet label. Both sources use the 60x44 board scale, confirmed by owner from the printed GHB (2026-10-27). Objective radius 3.79" = the 3" control zone around a 40mm marker. The map labels the red territory (side B) as the attacker's and the blue one (side A) as the defender's; attackerSide follows those labels, although the GHB text lets the attacker pick either territory. The terrain locations on the map are an optional suggested layout, so they are not included.
